title: Agent Recipe
description: A provider-neutral specification for an agent task. The recipe is House property. The model is the current electrical source. Any model that meets providerRequirements can execute a recipe; the recipe itself does not name a model.

recipeId.description: Stable identifier. Kebab-case. Examples: research-wayfinder, earth-signal-surveyor, graph-patch-extractor, citation-steward

purpose.description: One sentence: what this recipe accomplishes

allowedTools.description: Tool IDs from tool-capabilities.registry.yaml that this recipe may invoke. Empty = no tools.

requiredSchemas.description: Schema $id values this recipe produces or consumes

claimPermissions.description: Epistemic claim labels this recipe is allowed to produce. Recipes that only produce established-science claims must not emit speculative-theory claims.

providerRequirements.description: Minimum capabilities the executing model must have

evaluationSuite.description: Name of the Boxfire evaluation suite that must pass before this recipe reaches VERIFIED status

promptVersion.description: Version of the prompt template used by this recipe. Prompt templates live in Flameclyffe/prompts/.

consentScope.description: Maximum consent scope for outputs produced by this recipe

maxActiveNodes.description: Workspace capacity limit. Informed by jlens capacity experiments: ~20 before interference.

canWriteGraph.description: If false, produces patch proposals only. True requires explicit Steward authorisation in the registry.

requiresStewardReview.description: If true, all outputs require Steward review before they are considered accepted

specialists.description: Specialist agents this recipe may invoke

status.description: Only VERIFIED recipes may run in production Hearthgate contexts
